vo: Every day, thousands of shoppers walk through your store.
Almost all of them leave like ghosts. No name. No trace.
From her very first click, Convertive reads every move. Where she came from. What she wants. When she starts to hesitate.
Thirty-two seconds in, she's about to leave.
So Convertive stops the clock. It weighs every next move, and picks the one most likely to work. In forty-one milliseconds.
One offer. One email. And the ghost has a name.
Now imagine that, for every visitor, in every session.
Convertive. Convert anonymous visitors before they leave.
